paragraphs.text: Ihesia was the general-in-chief of Iwset in the Dark Age of Terisiare , on the plane of Dominaria .

Ihesia was the general-in-chief of Iwset , working under Lord Peemel . She employed her lover, the shapeshifter Isak Glen'Dard to act as a triple agent, ostensibly working for Peemel while appearing to serve the lord's advisor Digody in turn, only to report all the goings-on directly back to Ihesia. Although she had no magic, Ihesia's powers of seduction were of the utmost skill, easily wrapping even accomplished and independent people like Isak around her little finger.
